arguments.summary: A potential data exfiltration incident was detected from workstation WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) in the Finance department. The endpoint attempted to exfiltrate 2.3 GB of data via DNS tunneling to the external IP 203.0.113.77 using the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com. Correlation with SIEM and threat intelligence revealed prior Cobalt Strike C2 activity linked to another compromised host (WS-FIN-042) and the same C2 domain. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall, resetting credentials for the affected user (CORP\auser), and performing a full EPP scan (no threats found). No malicious payloads were identified on the source endpoint during analysis.
